resources.string: Optional protections you can enable manually
These protections are optional and stay separate from HardBlock’s automatic blocking protections.
Block installation from unknown app sources
Prevents unknown-source permission from being enabled again after you remove existing grants. Device Owner is used as an extra native layer when available.

First remove permissions that are already active. Tap Open settings. On Android’s “Install unknown apps” screen, open every app shown as allowed and turn off “Allow from this source”. Then return to HardBlock and confirm that you removed the current permissions. HardBlock will only apply the block after your confirmation.
Confirm the current permissions were removed

After turning off “Allow from this source” for the apps that had it enabled, confirm below. HardBlock cannot revoke those permissions from other apps automatically with the public Android APIs, so the block is not activated until you confirm this step.
I removed the permissions — enable block
